The '''sister''' of [[Troomis]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] following an altercation with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Creeve]]. Her brother, a member of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], vowed to get revenge on Creeve for her.
